description: §17.1 / §42.4: `if=g()` with an unresolved type is E-COND-NOT-BOOLEAN (annotate `g` `-> bool`, or write `if=(g() is given)`).
rationale: §17.1: "a value whose type the compiler cannot resolve is E-COND-NOT-BOOLEAN (§42.4)". Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S460 "a′, go" (supersedes S440 Truthiness Q2 for conditions; keeps S440 #4 = (c), Q1, Gotcha Q2, S442).
